description: Fork of exp154 (BitAttention reference, val_bpb=1.7105). Crazy idea: skip V projection entirely — pass x directly as the value tensor. v = x.unsqueeze(1).expand(B,H,T,E), so all heads share the same E=64 value vector; per-head differentiation comes from the q/k attention pattern only. attn output shape becomes [B,H,T,E] instead of [B,H,T,d_v]. To compensate, double out_proj's tph (3056→6112) — out_proj's input dim also grows (192→384) automatically. Tests whether v_lut is a meaningful information bottleneck or a redundant projection that out_proj can absorb. Removed: v_input_nap, v_tph (no v_lut anymore). Kept: BitAttention kernel (q,k still ±1 dominance vectors via V2D). Param budget should be ~similar to exp154 (~400k freed from v_lut, ~400k added to out_proj).
